name: nonApi_setKennelEmailOff
description: The unsubscribe link (E19.F3.S2). Sets the hasher's email-alert setting for the kennel to 2 (off) — the same value the app's dialog writes — and clears any per-run 'on' override (EventEmailAlertPreference 1 ⇒ 2) for that kennel's runs, so one tap really does stop the emails. Both writes are restamped by the HKM/HEM updatedAt triggers and re-sync, so the app shows the new setting. Called by the EmailUnsubscribe API endpoint after it has verified the signed token; no device auth. Idempotent. Both parameters are required (NULL ⇒ THROW ⇒ Success 0 envelope, logged). The success envelope is joined to HC.Kennel to return the kennel's name and slug for the confirmation page — see the code smell about an unknown kennel.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The hasher unsubscribing. Required. Default NULL.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: The kennel whose emails to stop. Required. Default NULL.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: One row { Success, ErrorMessage, kennelName, kennelSlug } on success or failure — EXCEPT that an unknown @kennelId returns ZERO rows after a successful no-op commit (the SELECT is FROM HC.Kennel WHERE id = @kennelId).

columns.name: Success
columns.description: 1 on success, 0 when the CATCH block ran.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: NULL on success; ERROR_MESSAGE() from the CATCH block on failure.

columns.name: kennelName
columns.description: HC.Kennel.KennelName, for the confirmation page; NULL on failure.

columns.name: kennelSlug
columns.description: HC.Kennel.KennelUniqueShortName, for the link back; NULL on failure.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap SET KennelEmailAlertPreference = 2 WHERE UserId = @userId AND KennelId = @kennelId AND removed = 0 AND not already 2 — the HKM trigger restamps updatedAt (row re-syncs).
UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap SET EventEmailAlertPreference = 2 for the hasher's rows on that kennel's events where it is 1 — the HEM trigger restamps updatedAt (rows re-sync).
Both inside one transaction. On any runtime error: rolls back, inserts one HC.ErrorLog row (HcVersion '<api>', userId, kennelId), returns the envelope with Success 0.

codeSmells.issue: Success envelope is a SELECT FROM HC.Kennel — an unknown kennelId returns no envelope at all
codeSmells.detail: Lines 42–44: SELECT 1 AS Success, … FROM HC.Kennel k WHERE k.id = @kennelId. When no kennel has that id (a stale or tampered token), both UPDATEs touch nothing, the transaction commits, and rowset 0 is EMPTY — neither Success 1 nor Success 0. A caller that reads row [0] gets an index error, or treats 'no envelope' as failure for a call that did not fail. Select the envelope unconditionally and LEFT JOIN or sub-select the kennel columns.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
